translations.web: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.
translations.bsb: You have filled my heart with more joy than when grain and new wine abound.
translations.kjv: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.
translations.asv: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, More than they have when their grain and their new wine are increased.
